title: Unimpressed.  a lot of plastic for not a lot of action.
text:
Unimpressed. a lot of plastic for not a lot of action.. I have a mini Nespresso machine, and this 'mini' still looks significant against the Nespresso machine. I purchased the 're-usable' cups and it is very easy to use. However, I think this one bulky plastic for making straight forward coffee: just stick to your french press. there seems to be a lot of plastic and not much of it is that functional. You need to add water every time you want a full cup of coffee, but the coffee stated weak - so I decided to only fill half of the water tank to make the coffee. I wish there was a way to control the water volume/cup size of coffee. I am pretty unimpressed and stopped using it after a couple of attempts and we are back to the Nespresso machine.
like other says, you do notice there is additional 30 seconds of 'hot water' heating before the brew is ready. Not that extensive unless you are standing right in front of it.
I think if you love K-cups, this machine is relatively small to other K machines. However, if you are a Nespresso person, this will not work. I am considering returning this machine.

description: The Keurig K-Mini single serve coffee maker features a sleek design with matte finish, and at less than 5 inches wide is the perfect size for any space or occasion. The K-Mini brewer is effortlessly simple to use - just add fresh water to the reservoir, pop in your favorite K-Cup pod, press the brew button and enjoy fresh brewed, delicious coffee in minutes. Choose from hundreds of delicious K-Cup pod varieties to enjoy 6-12oz of your favorite coffee, tea, cocoa, and iced beverages. With a single cup reservoir and cord storage, the K-Mini coffee maker is the portable brewer that makes anywhere perfect for great coffee. The K-Mini coffee maker is available in a variety of matte-finish colors.
